label: Kimi
description: Kimi API (Moonshot Open Platform) for Settings → LLMs. Install from Store → Gateways, then enable to show Kimi under Providers & Keys.

steps.title: Open Kimi
steps.body: Press the Kimi row in this table. The page slides open so you can paste your API key.

steps.title: API key
steps.body: Paste your Moonshot/Kimi API key from platform.kimi.ai.

steps.title: Test & Save
steps.body: Press Test & Save after you paste a key.

steps.title: Back
steps.body: Press Back to return to the provider list.
